class.name: GameplayWorld
class.brief_description: Composes the match state, optional authority, and world-scoped services.
class.description: GameplayWorld is the root lifetime boundary for the gameplay framework. A server composition supplies both [GameplayGameState] and [GameplayGameMode]. A client composition supplies only the shared game state. An optional world-scoped [GameplaySubsystemRegistry] is initialized and shut down with the world.

method.name: get_game_mode
method.description: Returns the authoritative game mode, or [code]null[/code] for a client composition.

method.name: get_subsystem_registry
method.description: Returns the optional world-scoped subsystem registry.

method.name: initialize_world
method.description: Initializes a client or server composition. The subsystem registry must use [constant GameplaySubsystem.SCOPE_WORLD].

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Returns whether this world composition is active.

method.name: shutdown_world
method.description: Deinitializes subsystems and clears the composition. Calling this repeatedly is safe.

signal.name: world_initialized
signal.description: Emitted after the world and its subsystems initialize.

signal.name: world_shutdown
signal.description: Emitted after the world shuts down.
